cpi_u.rank_rule: 1 plus the count of stored values strictly below the latest value

federal_funds.rank_rule: 1 plus the count of stored values strictly below the latest value

treasury_10_year_yield.rank_rule: 1 plus the count of stored values strictly below the latest value

assumptions: CPI-U 12-month percent change is (later index / earlier index - 1) * 100 when both months exist. Reported changes are rounded half up to 0.0001.
Federal funds and the 10-year yield are separate levels in percent per year. One-month changes are in percentage points.
Each latest value ranks as 1 plus the count of stored values strictly below it.
limitations: The euro-area HICP series ends December 2025 and is excluded. That series is ecb.icp.M.U2.Y.000000.3.INX, unit index, 2015 = 100, and it is not an input.
CPI-U is an index (1982-84=100), seasonally adjusted. A missing month is not interpolated.
Federal funds and the 10-year yield stay separate percent-per-year levels. Their seasonal adjustment is unknown. No real rate is calculated.
statistical_interpretation: Descriptive CPI-U 12-month percent change and separate federal funds and 10-year yield levels. Not a forecast.
narrative: CPI-U 12-month change from 2025-09-01 to 2026-09-01 is 4.0000 percent (index 300.000 to 312.000, 1982-84=100). The latest index ranks 6 among 6 stored values. The federal funds rate is 5.13 percent per year, a one-month change of 0.2500 percentage points. The 10-year yield is 4.27 percent per year, a one-month change of 0.2600 percentage points. No causal mechanism is established.
